sources.title: Muse Glimmer - Meta Model API
sources.snippet: Muse Glimmer is Meta's 30-billion-parameter open-source multimodal model, distilled from Muse Spark and built for local agentic workflows. Run it on your own hardware through supported runtimes. It ships with open weights, reads text and images, and reasons step by step before it answers.
